nombre_oficial.texto: The Corner of Londres and Allende

frase_gancho.texto: A house painted blue inside and out, as Carlos Pellicer described it.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Before you cross the gate, look at the color of the walls along Londres Street. Guillermo Kahlo, a German-born photographer and Frida’s father, built this house in nineteen oh four, with the rooms arranged around a courtyard. Frida was born here in nineteen oh seven. Years later, she and Diego Rivera made the house their home, filled it with folk art and pre-Hispanic pieces, and turned it into a manifesto of Mexican identity.
